services.name: Site Rentals
services.desc: Heritage Square Museum’s beautiful grounds and historic buildings create a unique and picturesque backdrop that is perfect for commercial filming and photography, weddings, portrait photography, and corporate or private events. Conveniently located just north of Downtown Los Angeles in the historic Arroyo Seco, the museum resides on approximately 10 acres of land and is comprised of eight landmark structures in various states of restoration. Please note that walk-in photo sessions are not permitted. Anyone wishing to do any sort of photography session on-site must acquire permission ahead of time.
